label: Seedance 2.5 (hosted, Comfy Router)
_note: ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 as a hosted model through Comfy Router (byteplus/dreamina-seedance-2-5-260628, docs.comfy.org/development/comfy-router/models/byteplus/dreamina-seedance-2-5-260628). No workflow: a render is one Router call (router_call in compile.py). Its prompt is prose with the spoken lines (the ltx2 writer, builtin video_prose); its references go in as separate reference images (each subject's sheet, then the plate), and a shot's first/last keyframes as first_frame/last_frame. It makes its own sound and can't be handed a recording, so every audio policy renders as generate. Not yet tried against the live service (docs/PLAN.md, step 4).

capabilities._note: Hosted: Router only, and the provider decides what a seed means (a take can't be promised to come out the same again). Reference images: up to 30 a request (BytePlus ModelArk and ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 announcement: 30 images, 10 videos and 10 audio clips, 50 in all; more is refused whole): subjects first, then the plate when there is room.

template._note: Whole seconds from 4 to 30 (Seedance 2.5's duration), at 24 fps: 96 + 24k frames. 720p by default; its sizes are named (480p, 720p, 1080p), and the picture's shape comes from the nearest of its ratios.

multishot._note: A continuous: multishot group in prose (docs/MULTISHOT.md): the look once, then a paragraph a shot, each a hard cut from the one before; the model times the cuts (Seedance's own scenes cut where it chose, Higgsfield 2026-10-25). Up to 30 pictures, so every shot's plate.

policy_fallback.why: Seedance makes its own sound and can't be given a recording to dub; lay the recording in at the edit

reference_image._note: The shot's subjects' sheets and its plate, sent as separate reference images (compile.py router_call), never composed into one picture as VACE's are.

size_hints.keyframe: the render size, or any size of the same shape

router._note: How a shot becomes Seedance 2.5's own request (targets/generic/router_video.py): BytePlus's content list (the prose, then the pictures with their roles), each picture through the Seedance virtual library (BytePlus refuses a photoreal person, an AI-made one too, as a plain URL: content_policy_violation, 2026-10-11).

ratio.name: ratio
ratio._note: first-frame / first-last-frame generation follows the frame's shape: a concrete ratio is refused

seed.name: seed
seed._note: Router's schema says [-1, 2^32-1], but BytePlus finishes any request with a seed past 2^31-1 as invalid_input (2026-10-11: Router's own example rendered; the same with seed 2454889240 was refused in 5 s, as were sh040's and sh190's takes). So seeds wrap at 2^31.

router._draft_note: A proxy take is a Seedance Draft (draft: true, 480p): POST /seriesmith/render with from_draft makes its final from the draft's task id, at 1080p, within 7 days (the provider reuses the draft's prompt, pictures, length, ratio, seed and sound).

presets._note: No model files and no steps: the provider's. Final at 720p, proxy at 480p.
